correction_rule.name: rewrite
correction_rule.formula: 2 s + 0.7895 s/char * len(truth) per wrong commit
correction_rule.prefix: a wrong prefix of k words costs the penalty of the first k words of the truth

reading_cost.formula: 0.5 s + 0.3 s/word * k per commit (right or wrong); prefix commits with fewer than 1 word(s) count as no commit
reading_cost.note: the adopted safe-wpm/0.2 reading cost (2026-11-22) is 0.5 s + 0.3 s/word per commit, minimum prefix 1 word; other values give a sensitivity variant

safe_wpm_v02.note: the calibration found no certified threshold (policy never commits)

notes: Calibration on the closed-loop trials of the train + val splits of the 7 earlier sessions (the docs name the val trials; train trials are open as well and the RNN output is fixed).

2026-11-25: the scope line now says that the bound covers the pool of all sessions of one participant, not each session (trust guarantee section 4). Basis: the pooled-guard check (commit 74a21f8; https://github.com/zhangzibo/fidetype/blob/main/experiments/2026-11-25-pooled-guard-check/results.md). No number changed.
